# test_sop {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
test_sop(data, d1, d2; chart_choice, refinement=OrdinaryType(), alpha=0.05, add_noise=false)
```
Perform the asymptotic hypothesis test for spatial dependence based on spatial ordinal patterns (SOPs) and return a [`SOPTestResult`](SOPTestResult.qmd) with the test statistic, the asymptotic critical value, the p-value, and the reject decision.
 
  * `data`: data matrix (spatial field).
  * `d1::Int`: row delay.
  * `d2::Int`: column delay.
  * `chart_choice`: one of [`TauHat`](TauHat.qmd)`()`, [`KappaHat`](KappaHat.qmd)`()`, [`TauTilde`](TauTilde.qmd)`()`, [`KappaTilde`](KappaTilde.qmd)`()` (two-sided test), or [`Shannon()`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.Shannon), [`ShannonExtropy()`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.ShannonExtropy), [`DistanceToWhiteNoise()`](DistanceToWhiteNoise.qmd) (one-sided, upper-tail test with rescaled statistic). For [`Shannon`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.Shannon) and [`ShannonExtropy`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.ShannonExtropy), the logarithm base must be larger than 1. The statistic does not depend on it.
  * `refinement`: [`OrdinaryType`](OrdinaryType.qmd)`()` for the classical SOP classification, or one of [`RotationType`](RotationType.qmd)`()`, [`DirectionType`](DirectionType.qmd)`()`, [`DiagonalType`](DiagonalType.qmd)`()` (only for the entropy-type charts).
  * `alpha=0.05`: significance level.
  * `add_noise::Bool=false`: add uniform noise to the data to break ties (recommended for discrete-valued data).


:::
